transcript: Speaker A: ಇದು ನನ್ನ ಮೊದಲ ಇಂಟರ್ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್ ಟ್ರಿಪ್ [This is my first international trip] Speaker B: This is my first international trip. on_screen_text: ಇದು ನನ್ನ ಮೊದಲ INTERNATIONAL TRIP. THIS IS MY FIRST INTERNATIONAL TRIP. ನನಗೆ WINDOW SEAT ತುಂಬಾ ಇಷ್ಟ. I LOVE WINDOW SEATS. ನಾವು ಯಾವ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ LAND ಆಗ್ತೀವಿ? WHAT TIME WILL WE LAND? 15 MIN. ENGLISH. 1 RUPEE. APP INSTALL. JOURNEY. MySivi English speaking app Install Now.
summary: A woman practices English translation with an AI robot on a plane. The robot then promotes the MySivi app, highlighting that users can learn English through Kannada for just 15 minutes a day starting at 1 rupee. The ad concludes with a call to download the app.
